crossRefs.note: then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
Yah has punished me severely, but he has not given me over to death.
There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way: whoever hates reproof shall die.
Discipline your son, for there is hope; don’t be a willing party to his death.
You have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children, “My son, don’t take lightly the chastening…
for whom the Lord loves, he disciplines, and chastises every son whom he receives.”
For they indeed, for a few days, punished us as seemed good to them; but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of…
Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing causes them to stumble.
The work of righteousness will be peace, and the effect of righteousness, quietness and confidence forever.
Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance;
for God’s Kingdom is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.
For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory,
But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,
gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits…
Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.
But solid food is for those who are full grown, who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern good and…
But refuse profane and old wives’ fables. Exercise yourself toward godliness.
For bodily exercise has some value, but godliness has value in all things, having the promise of the life which is now…
having eyes full of adultery, and who can’t cease from sin; enticing unsettled souls; having a heart trained in greed…

translations.web: All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been trained by it.
translations.bsb: No discipline seems enjoyable at the time, but painful. Later on, however, it yields a harvest of righteousness and peace to those who have been trained by it.
translations.kjv: Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby.
translations.asv: All chastening seemeth for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yieldeth peaceable fruit unto them that have been exercised thereby, even the fruit of righteousness.
